AADHAAR_BANK_VALIDATION.user_facing_reason: The bank may need to validate the Aadhaar-linked DBT details.
questions: Do you know whether your Aadhaar is seeded to the bank account used for DBT?
AADHAAR_BANK_VALIDATION.remedy: Ask the bank to verify Aadhaar-bank DBT validation for this account.
AADHAAR_BANK_VALIDATION.citizen_action: Carry the bank passbook and identity document and ask for DBT/Aadhaar validation.
AADHAAR_BANK_VALIDATION.escalation: Use the bank's official branch or customer-support channel.
AADHAAR_BANK_VALIDATION.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the bank.

AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.user_facing_reason: The citizen reported that Aadhaar is not seeded to the DBT bank account.
AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.remedy: Request Aadhaar seeding for DBT at the bank.
AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.citizen_action: Ask the bank to seed the Aadhaar number for DBT and provide an acknowledgement.
AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.escalation: Use the bank's official branch or customer-support channel.
AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the bank.

BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID.user_facing_reason: The citizen reported that the account details used for payment are invalid.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID.remedy: Correct the account details with the submitting scheme office or portal.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID.citizen_action: Compare the passbook details with the application and request correction through the official application channel.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID.escalation: Contact the scheme office or official application helpdesk.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the scheme office.

BANK_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.user_facing_reason: The citizen reported that the bank account is inactive.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.remedy: Ask the bank how to reactivate the account before requesting payment reprocessing.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.citizen_action: Visit or contact the bank and retain the service acknowledgement.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.escalation: Use the bank's official branch or customer-support channel.
BANK_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the bank.

NAME_MISMATCH.user_facing_reason: The name in the payment records may differ from the verified identity or bank record.
NAME_MISMATCH.remedy: Verify which record is correct and request correction through the record owner's official channel.
NAME_MISMATCH.citizen_action: Carry the identity document, bank passbook, and application acknowledgement when requesting correction.
NAME_MISMATCH.escalation: Contact the organization that owns the incorrect record.
NAME_MISMATCH.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the record owner.

DUPLICATE_BENEFICIARY.user_facing_reason: The citizen reported a possible duplicate beneficiary record.
DUPLICATE_BENEFICIARY.remedy: Ask the scheme office to review and merge or correct duplicate beneficiary records.
DUPLICATE_BENEFICIARY.citizen_action: Provide application acknowledgement and identity document; do not submit duplicate applications.
DUPLICATE_BENEFICIARY.escalation: Contact the scheme office or official application helpdesk.
DUPLICATE_BENEFICIARY.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the scheme office.

PAYMENT_REJECTED.user_facing_reason: The citizen reported that the payment was rejected.
PAYMENT_REJECTED.remedy: Request the rejection reason and correction path from the scheme office.
PAYMENT_REJECTED.citizen_action: Share the payment acknowledgement or rejection message with the scheme office.
PAYMENT_REJECTED.escalation: Contact the scheme office or official application helpdesk.
PAYMENT_REJECTED.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the scheme office.

PAYMENT_NOT_RELEASED.user_facing_reason: The citizen reported that an approved payment has not been released.
PAYMENT_NOT_RELEASED.remedy: Ask the scheme office for the current payment release status.
PAYMENT_NOT_RELEASED.citizen_action: Keep the application acknowledgement and ask the official scheme office for a status update.
PAYMENT_NOT_RELEASED.escalation: Contact the scheme office or official application helpdesk.
PAYMENT_NOT_RELEASED.source_reference: Citizen-provided information; verify with the scheme office.

UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_FAILURE.user_facing_reason: The available citizen-provided information does not identify a specific payment failure.
UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_FAILURE.remedy: Request a written payment status or failure reason from the scheme office and bank.
UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_FAILURE.citizen_action: Collect the application acknowledgement, bank passbook entry, and any official messages.
UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_FAILURE.escalation: Contact the scheme office and bank through official channels.
UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_FAILURE.source_reference: Insufficient citizen-provided information; manual verification required.

NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.user_facing_reason: The citizen does not have enough information to safely identify the payment problem.
NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.remedy: Obtain the missing status information before choosing a correction.
NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.citizen_action: Ask the scheme office or bank for a written status or rejection reason.
NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.escalation: Use the official scheme helpdesk or bank channel.
NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.source_reference: Citizen selected I don't know; no system records were accessed.
